# Three.js runtime files

This directory contains the minimal browser runtime used by the static explorer:

- `three.module.js`
- `three.core.min.js`
- `addons/controls/OrbitControls.js`
- `addons/loaders/PLYLoader.js`

All files are copied unmodified from `three@0.185.1`. The upstream MIT license is
included in `LICENSE`.
